phrases.text: O believers!
Do not take My enemies and yours as trusted allies, showing them affection even though they deny what has come to you of the truth.
phrases.ar: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ

phrases.text: They drove the Messenger and yourselves out ˹of Mecca˺, simply for your belief in Allah, your Lord.
phrases.ar: يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ

phrases.text: If you ˹truly˺ emigrated to struggle in My cause and seek My pleasure, ˹then do not take them as allies,˺ disclosing secrets ˹of the believers˺ to the pagans out of affection for them,
when I know best whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal.
phrases.ar: وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ

phrases.text: And whoever of you does this has truly strayed from the Right Way
If they gain the upper hand over you, they would be your ˹open˺ enemies, unleashing their hands and tongues to harm you,
phrases.ar: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ

phrases.text: and wishing that you would abandon faith
Neither your relatives nor children will benefit you on Judgment Day
phrases.ar: لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلا أَوْلادُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ

phrases.text: He will decide between you ˹all˺.
phrases.ar: يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ

phrases.text: For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
phrases.ar: وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

phrases.text: You already have an excellent example in Abraham and those with him,
when they said to their people, “We totally dissociate ourselves from you and ˹shun˺ whatever ˹idols˺ you worship besides Allah.
We reject you.

The enmity and hatred that has arisen between us and you will last until you believe in Allah alone.” The only exception is when Abraham said to his father, “I will seek forgiveness for you,˹” adding, “but˺ I cannot protect you from Allah at all.” ˹The believers prayed,˺ “Our Lord!
phrases.ar: إِلا قَوْلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لأبِيهِ لأسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ

phrases.text: In You we trust.
And to You we ˹always˺ turn.
And to You is the final return
Our Lord!
Do not subject us to the persecution of the disbelievers.
Forgive us, our Lord!
phrases.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

phrases.text: You ˹alone˺ are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.”
You certainly have an excellent example in them for whoever has hope in Allah and the Last Day.
phrases.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ

phrases.text: But whoever turns away,
phrases.ar: وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ

phrases.text: then surely Allah ˹alone˺ is the Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy
˹In time,˺ Allah may bring about goodwill between you and those of them you ˹now˺ hold as enemies.
phrases.ar: عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ

phrases.text: For Allah is Most Capable.
And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.ar: وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ

phrases.text: Allah does not forbid you from dealing kindly and fairly with those who have neither fought nor driven you out of your homes.
phrases.ar: وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ

phrases.text: Surely Allah loves those who are fair
phrases.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ

phrases.text: Allah only forbids you from befriending those who have fought you for ˹your˺ faith, driven you out of your homes,
phrases.ar: عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ

phrases.text: or supported ˹others˺ in doing so.
And whoever takes them as friends,
then it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers
O believers!
When the believing women come to you as emigrants, test their intentions
phrases.ar: الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ

phrases.text: their faith is best known to Allah
and if you find them to be believers,
then do not send them back to the disbelievers.
phrases.ar: فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ لا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ

phrases.text: These ˹women˺ are not lawful ˹wives˺ for the disbelievers,
nor are the disbelievers lawful ˹husbands˺ for them. ˹But˺ repay the disbelievers whatever ˹dowries˺ they had paid.
And there is no blame on you if you marry these ˹women˺ as long as you pay them their dowries.
And do not hold on to marriage with polytheistic women. ˹But˺ demand ˹repayment of˺ whatever ˹dowries˺ you had paid,
phrases.ar: وَلا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ

phrases.text: and let the disbelievers do the same.
That is the judgment of Allah
He judges between you.
And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
And if any of your wives desert you to the disbelievers,
phrases.ar: شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ

phrases.text: and later you take spoils from them,
then pay those whose wives have gone, the equivalent of whatever ˹dowry˺ they had paid.
And be mindful of Allah, in Whom you believe
phrases.ar: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ

phrases.text: O Prophet!
phrases.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ

phrases.text: When the believing women come to you, pledging to you that they will neither associate anything with Allah ˹in worship˺,
phrases.ar: وَلا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ

phrases.text: nor steal, nor fornicate,
nor kill their children,
nor falsely attribute ˹illegitimate˺ children to their husbands,
nor disobey you in what is right,
then accept their pledge,
phrases.ar: وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ

phrases.text: and ask Allah to forgive them.
Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
O believers!
Do not ally yourselves with a people Allah is displeased with.
phrases.ar: قَدْ يَئِسُوا مِنَ الآخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ

phrases.text: They already have no hope for the Hereafter, just like the disbelievers lying in ˹their˺ graves
